game_concept: A quiz RPG set in The Kingdom – Wall Battlements, the high battlements: the squire must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected banners into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the granary door.
theme: The Kingdom – Wall Battlements: the high battlements
core_gameplay_loop: In Wall Battlements, repeat each round: Drag collected banners into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the granary door. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about crate_b to power up the squire and open the granary door.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Wall Battlements'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Wall Battlements.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
